To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
females with low SE are more prone to develop a POSI, which is related to a preference for anonymous and unstructured online communication.
females with poor SE are more likely to develop a preference to interact online, which, in turn is a risk factor for IA.

(1) the association between SE, POSI, and IA is stronger for females, (2) POSI mediates the relationship between SE, and (3) the subjective relevance attributed to some Internet features mediates the association between SE.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the role of SE, POSI, and the perceived relevance of Internet features in the relationship between poor social skills (in the form of low SE) and IA.
the role of SE in IA and its relation with POSI and the perception of Internet attributes.
the role of POSI in the link between SE and IA.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
, among females, low SE is a significant predictor of IA, and that this relationship is mediated by POSI, which, in turn is mediated by the perception of Internet attributes.
the association between SE, POSI, and IA among adolescents is more likely to be mediated by POSI among females than among males.
POSI and the perceived importance of some Internet features may play a role in the relationship between IA and SE, at least for female adolescents.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the relationship between SE, the perceived relevance of Internet features, POSI, and IA is complex and differs between genders.
females with lower self-esteem are more likely to develop a preference to use the Web for social interaction.
the relationship between low self-esteem and problematic Internet use is partially mediated by preference for online social interactions and by the subjective relevance of Internet features.
The main takeaway from our work is that
POSI is an important mediator of the relationship between SE problems and IA among adolescents, especially among females.
the association between SE, POSI, and IA is complex, and that the role of POSI is not straightforward.
the link between poor SE and IA is mediated by POSI and perceived relevance of some features of the Web.
